components.text:
Circle: small circle, ritual chalk.

Condenses your magicules into one Condensed Magicule: it takes 5,000 magicules from you (the server's rite file can change that).

Anyone can perform it. The magicules come from the caster, not from the altar, so this rite asks for no altar power. Tensura must be installed.

With too few magicules it fails: nothing is taken and the items come back.
